  [Life Sciences]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Life Sciences overview][188]
  **Real-World Data**
  [NLP-Enriched EHR Data Solutions][189] Large-scale, high-quality health data sets.
  **Real-World Evidence**
  [Real-World Evidence][190] Retrospective and prospective research by RWE experts.
  [Real-World Evidence Analytics Platform][191] SaaS application enabling efficient analysis of
  real-world data.
  **Point of Care Marketing**
  [Digital Health Media][192] Highly targeted brand awareness messaging in the EHR.*
* [Health Plans + Payers][193]
  [Health Plan Payers]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Health Plans + Payers overview][194]
  **Gap Closure**
  [Gap Closure Services][195] Proactive, clinically-driven services to help health plans and their
  network providers close care gaps.
  [Care Gap Alerting][196] Point-of-care care gap alerting.
  [Provider Engagement Solutions][197] Streamlined payer-provider collaboration for better gap
  closure.
  **Risk Adjustment**
  [Health Equity Analytics][198] Go beyond Social Determinants of Health (SDoH).
  [Risk Adjustment Analytics][199] Analytics to find and prioritize gaps and opportunities.
  [Risk Mitigator][200] RADV audits - be prepared, not scared.
  [Comprehensive Submissions][201] One cloud-based data management platform for all government
  programs.
  [Utilization Analytics][202] Delivers visibility needed to monitor and manage key performance
  indicators.
  **Data Exchange + Coding**
  [eChart Courier][203] Automated electronic chart retrieval.
  [eChart Coder][204] Boost productivity and reduce costs with Veradigm eChart Coder.
  [eChart Integration and Analytics][205] Automated exchange of clinical data and medical record
  information for analysis.
  **Quality Management**
  [Quality Analytics][206] Proven analytic solution to help plans enhance Quality performance across
  their member base.
  [Risk Adjustment and Quality Management][207] Real-time visibility to monitor and manage your KPIs
  for risk and quality alike.
  **Clearinghouse + EDI**
  [Veradigm Payerpath][208] Claims and risk adjustment solution including an effective collaboration
  delivering streamlined EDI.
* [Healthcare Providers][209]
  [Healthcare Provider]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Healthcare Providers overview][210]
  **Our Platform**
  [Veradigm Suite][211] Explore Veradigm’s powerful healthcare solutions designed to streamline
  operations, improve patient care, and boost practice efficiency.
  **Streamline Practice Operations**
  [Practice Management][212] Simplified software for effortless scheduling, billing, and claims
  processing.
  [AI Patient Scheduling][213] Automate and optimize patient scheduling with artificial
  intelligence.
  **Improve Clinical Efficiency**
  [EHR Software][214] Adaptable ambulatory EHR platform that supports your clinical documentation
  and workflow needs.
  [ePrescribe][215] Affordable and certified e-Prescribing solution including controlled substances.
  [Gap Closure Alerting][216] Point-of-care care gap alerting.
  [Clinical Data Registries][217] Registry participation for providers.
  [eChart Courier][218] Save time, reduce costs, and increase efficiency by automating medical chart
  retrieval.
  **Maximize Revenue**
  [Revenue Cycle Services][219] Let us handle billing, minimize denials, enhance coding, and ensure
  timely payments.
  [Coding Services][220] Get help to reduce staff burden and increase revenue - let our team manage
  coding for you.
  [Veradigm Payerpath][221] All-in-one revenue cycle management solution that features a top-tier
  clearinghouse.
  [Veradigm Intelligent Payments][222] Simplify patient billing and boost collections with
  intelligent, automated payments.
  **Engage Patients**
  [Patient Engagement Platform][223] Integrate with a mobile-first patient engagement platform.
  **Optimize Resources and Spend**
  [ERP Fiscal Management][224] Automate finance workflows and improve visibility into spend,
  reporting, and compliance.
  [ERP Point of Use][225] Track supply usage in clinical settings to reduce waste and improve
  accuracy.
  [ERP Supply Chain][226] Streamline purchasing and inventory with real-time visibility from
  requisition to delivery.
* [Health IT Vendors][227]
  [Veradigm Network]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Healthcare IT Vendor Solutions overview][228]
  **Powered by the Network**
  [Life Sciences][229] Empowering life science with trusted data and insights from the point of
  care.
  [Health Plans + Payers][230] Connecting payers to the Veradigm Network’s comprehensive, national
  provider footprint.
  [Providers][231] Integrated clinical & financial solutions for a healthier practice.
  **API Connectivity**
  [Veradigm Connect][232] Connect the latest health tech solutions with the physicians and patients
  who need them.
  [App Expo][233] Become one of hundreds of certified applications and devices for provider
  practices built on open APIs.
  [Diagnostic Ordering and Results Network (DORN)][234] Connecting EHR Vendors with Lab and
  Radiology centers.
  **Electronic Prescribing**
  [Veradigm ePrescribe Enterprise][235] Integrated, advanced, easy-to-use ePrescribing for EHR and
  HIT vendors.
* [Insights][236]
  [Two hands typing on a laptop]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Filter through all of Veradigm's Insights][237]
  **Veradigm Insights**
  [Blog Posts][238] Read through our collection of valuable insights.
  [Videos][239] Watch our videos to learn more about our offerings.
  [Thought Leadership][240] Read the latest healthcare insights from our team of subject matter
  experts.
  [Podcasts][241] Listen to our podcasts to hear healthcare insights from our team of experts.
  [Webinars][242] Watch our webinars to learn more about how we are transforming health,
  insightfully.
  **Resources**
  [RWE Publications][243] Read through our RWE publications and learn how we help clients.
  [Clinical Data Registries][244] Explore our registry publications and learn how we help clients.
  [*Smart Medicine* Podcast][245] Thought-provoking podcast dedicated to understanding the
  intersection of care and innovation
  **Trending Topics**
  [Value-Based Care][246] Comprehensive guide to value-based care, including use cases, relevant
  blog articles, white papers and more.
  [Real-World Evidence][247] Complete overview of real-world evidence, why it’s important, and how
  it’s used in healthcare.
  [Real-World Data][248] Thorough review of what real-world healthcare data is, how it’s collected,
  and how it’s used across the healthcare spectrum.
  [Payer Provider Relationships Guide][249] Discover the impact of payer-provider relationships on
  healthcare. Learn how collaboration improves patient care and addresses challenges.

# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]

# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]

the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This

  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the

where they need them.

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

## **About Artesia General Hospital**

Artesia General Hospital provides 24/7 emergency care, Walk-In Care, primary care, and specialty
services across Artesia, Carlsbad, Roswell, Hobbs, and surrounding southeastern New Mexico
communities. AGH has cared for this region since 1939.

As a [**DNV accredited**][33] nonprofit community hospital, AGH combines advanced technology with
the personal attention you’d expect from a provider who knows your name. We’re proud to be New
Mexico’s only Great Place to Work® certified hospital.

# CMR: The Emergency Department EHR Built by ED Clinicians, for ED Clinicians

#### Streamline patient care, enhance revenue capture, and ensure regulatory compliance with our
#### browser-based EDIS.

Designed and continually refined by seasoned ED physicians and nurses, CMR’s Emergency Department
Information System (EDIS) addresses every step of the patient journey—from triage to discharge.
Fully **browser-based**, CMR minimizes hardware costs and allows staff to document anytime,
anywhere.

[Request a demo][10]

# Highlights

CMR helps emergency departments of all sizes—from freestanding EDs and critical access hospitals to
multi-facility health systems—deliver efficient, high-quality patient care. Our intuitive,
clinically driven interface reduces time spent on documentation, speeds decision-making, and
maximizes charge capture. Backed by 24/7 clinical and technical support, CMR empowers your ED to run
at peak performance while meeting CMS, TJC, and industry requirements.

[
Learn more
][11]
* **Faster, Intuitive ED Workflow:** Chart and track patients with fewer clicks
* **Seamless Integration:** HL7 interfaces with your hospital HIS, billing, labs, imaging, and more
* **Proven ROI:** Increase revenue through complete documentation and reduced coding errors

# Features at a Glance

Whether you’re seeking to reduce wait times, streamline documentation, improve quality metrics, or
capture every billable service, CMR delivers the robust functionality you need—without disrupting
the fast-paced demands of emergency care.
* **Patient Tracking Whiteboard** for instant overview of patient status and location
* **Intuitive Clinician Documentation** with minimal clicks, guided prompts, and advanced clinical
  decision support
* **Integrated Ordering and Results** for labs, imaging, and pharmacy
* **Real-time Charge Capture **to reduce missed charges and improve revenue cycle efficiency
* **Seamless Interoperability **with your HIS, telehealth platforms, HIEs, and more
* **Scalable **from small rural facilities to large urban systems and freestanding EDs

## Product Overview

### Clinician Workflow

### Revenue and Compliance

**Nurse Charting:** Intuitive templates, dynamic vital sign alerts, and direct care-path prompts
ensure complete, compliant documentation
**Real-Time Charge Capture:** Automated prompts ensure no missed or undercoded charges
**Physician Documentation:** Speedy “click-and-go” charting with free text or voice recognition
options, embedded with risk management guidelines
**Accuracy & Speed:** Precisely coded services and reduced claim rejections
**Clinical Decision Support:** Drug interaction checks, allergy alerts, and best-practice prompts
appear only when relevant—helping reduce alert fatigue
**Compliance Monitoring:** Hard stops and configurable alerts ensure staff capture mandatory
elements
**Triage to Disposition:** Streamlined triage forms, robust order management, real-time handoff
tools, and discharge instructions keep patient flow moving
**Audit Trail & Reporting:** Full transparency with user logs for privacy and legal readiness

# Cloud-Ready and Browser-Based: Technology That Scales with You
* **Flexible Hosting:** Offload server maintenance, security patches, and 24/7 monitoring so IT
  teams can focus on strategic projects
* **Advanced Interoperability:** HL7, FHIR, CCD, and direct messaging integrations ensure broad
  compatibility with other systems
* ‍**Secure & Reliable:** Enterprise-grade cybersecurity features protect patient data and reduce
  downtime
* ‍**Scalability:** Expand easily with patient volume—ideal for freestanding EDs, rural hospitals,
  and multi-hospital systems

# 24/7 Clinical & Technical Support
# You Can Count On!

We understand that emergency departments never close. That’s why CMR offers **round-the-clock**
support with live experts—no third-party vendors, no tedious phone trees. From initial planning and
implementation to ongoing optimization, our dedicated team of ED-trained clinicians and IT
specialists is always on call.
* **Onsite or Virtual Go-Live Training:** Real-world scenarios to ensure quick adoption
* **Implementation Planning & Workflow Analysis:** Partnering with you to map how CMR fits your
  unique ED processes
* **Ongoing Education:** Webinars, best-practice tips, and user forums to keep your team current
* **24/7 Help Desk: **Immediate triage and resolution for technical or urgent clinical workflow
  questions
* **Dedicated Account Managers: **A single point of contact to coordinate updates, gather feedback,
  and ensure satisfaction

* **Freestanding Emergency Centers**: Seamlessly handle walk-ins, short-term observation, integrated

# About Us

#### Over 20 Years of Emergency Medicine Expertise

Headquartered in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, CMR was founded by experienced ED physicians and
operational leaders who recognized the need for an **EDIS built by clinicians, for clinicians.** For
more than two decades, we’ve continually evolved our product to address the real-world challenges
facing emergency medicine.What sets us apart is our **deep clinical roots** and unwavering
commitment to **customer support**. Our development and support teams collaborate daily with
practicing ED physicians, nurses, and IT professionals to continually advance and refine the system.
From single-site critical access hospitals to large multi-facility networks, our clients rely on CMR
for dependable performance and proven results.**Our Mission:** Empower emergency departments to
provide safe, efficient, and financially sound care. We believe when clinicians spend less time on
documentation hassles, they can spend more time saving lives.

We understand that emergency departments never close. That’s why CMR offers **round-the-clock**
support with live experts—no third-party vendors, no tedious phone trees. From initial planning and
implementation to ongoing optimization, our dedicated team of ED-trained clinicians and IT
specialists is always on call.
* **Onsite or Virtual Go-Live Training:** Real-world scenarios to ensure quick adoption
* **Implementation Planning & Workflow Analysis:** Partnering with you to map how CMR fits your
  unique ED processes
* **Ongoing Education:** Webinars, best-practice tips, and user forums to keep your team current
* **24/7 Help Desk: **Immediate triage and resolution for technical or urgent clinical workflow
  questions
* **Dedicated Account Managers: **A single point of contact to coordinate updates, gather feedback,
  and ensure satisfaction

# WHO WE SERVE

#### CMR’s flexible architecture, robust feature set, and tailored training make it the perfect fit
#### for:
* **Freestanding Emergency Centers**: Seamlessly handle walk-ins, short-term observation, integrated
  billing, and more
* ‍**Rural Hospitals**: Limited IT resources? Our hosted solution and easy-to-use workflows keep
  costs in check and adoption smooth
* ‍**Urban/Suburban Hospitals**: Manage high-volume, high-acuity cases with real-time tracking and
  advanced clinical decision support

# About Us

#### Over 20 Years of Emergency Medicine Expertise

Headquartered in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, CMR was founded by experienced ED physicians and
operational leaders who recognized the need for an **EDIS built by clinicians, for clinicians.** For
more than two decades, we’ve continually evolved our product to address the real-world challenges
facing emergency medicine.What sets us apart is our **deep clinical roots** and unwavering
commitment to **customer support**. Our development and support teams collaborate daily with
practicing ED physicians, nurses, and IT professionals to continually advance and refine the system.
From single-site critical access hospitals to large multi-facility networks, our clients rely on CMR
for dependable performance and proven results.**Our Mission:** Empower emergency departments to
provide safe, efficient, and financially sound care. We believe when clinicians spend less time on
documentation hassles, they can spend more time saving lives.

# Exceptional People,
# Exceptional Outcomes

## A Medical Device Company Driven by a Shared Mission

As a global medical equipment manufacturer, we embrace a people-first culture that starts with a
mission to support our healthcare partners and the patients they serve. We design, build, and
distribute clinical products and surgical technologies for Orthopedic and General surgical
specialties, as well as patient monitoring needs, to medical institutions around the world —
enabling optimal patient outcomes.

[ Start a Conversation ][166]
[Four medical Professionals walking down a hallway]

### A Boldly Innovative Insufflation Solution

AirSeal^{®} is the only insufflator backed by clinical data* - positively affecting your patients'
intra and postoperative outcomes.

[ Learn More About AirSeal^{®} ][167]
[ Review the Data ][168]

### BioBrace^{®} Reinforced Bioinductive Implant

### The future of healing

The BioBrace^{®} implant combines the biological healing potential of highly porous Type I collagen
with the mechanical strength of PLLA microfilaments to support tendon healing. Engineered to protect
repairs during the vulnerable healing phase, the BioBrace^{®} implant promotes tissue growth,
reduces stress on healing tissue, and supports the body's natural healing processes.

[ Learn More About BioBrace^{®} ][169]
[ See the Data ][170]

### Y-Knotless™ Flex All-Suture Knotless Anchor: Shuttle with Ease. Fixate with Confidence.

The next generation of knotless technology is here with Y-Knotless™ Flex. Engineered for effortless
shuttling and designed to provide color-coded clarity during each step of the procedure.

# Exceptional People,
# Exceptional Outcomes

## A Medical Device Company Driven by a Shared Mission

As a global medical equipment manufacturer, we embrace a people-first culture that starts with a
mission to support our healthcare partners and the patients they serve. We design, build, and
distribute clinical products and surgical technologies for Orthopedic and General surgical
specialties, as well as patient monitoring needs, to medical institutions around the world —
enabling optimal patient outcomes.

[ Start a Conversation ][166]
[Four medical Professionals walking down a hallway]

### A Boldly Innovative Insufflation Solution

AirSeal^{®} is the only insufflator backed by clinical data* - positively affecting your patients'
intra and postoperative outcomes.

[ Learn More About AirSeal^{®} ][167]
[ Review the Data ][168]

### BioBrace^{®} Reinforced Bioinductive Implant

### The future of healing

The BioBrace^{®} implant combines the biological healing potential of highly porous Type I collagen
with the mechanical strength of PLLA microfilaments to support tendon healing. Engineered to protect
repairs during the vulnerable healing phase, the BioBrace^{®} implant promotes tissue growth,
reduces stress on healing tissue, and supports the body's natural healing processes.

[ Learn More About BioBrace^{®} ][169]
[ See the Data ][170]

### Y-Knotless™ Flex All-Suture Knotless Anchor: Shuttle with Ease. Fixate with Confidence.

The next generation of knotless technology is here with Y-Knotless™ Flex. Engineered for effortless
shuttling and designed to provide color-coded clarity during each step of the procedure.

[ Learn More About Y-Knotless™ Flex ][171]

FasterCapital is a global venture builder and online incubator dedicated to co-funding and
co-founding innovative startups. Established in 2014, we are now #1 venture builder in terms of
number of startups that we have helped, money invested and money raised. We have supported over 1620
startups in raising more than $2.8 billion, while directly investing over 1 billion in 1145
companies. Our comprehensive support system includes a worldwide network of [mentors][166],
[investors][167], and [strategic partners][168], allowing us to transform ideas into scalable,
market-ready businesses.

# **Who We Are**

FasterCapital is a global venture builder and online incubator dedicated to co-funding and
co-founding innovative startups. Established in 2014, we are now #1 venture builder in terms of
number of startups that we have helped, money invested and money raised. We have supported over 1620
startups in raising more than $2.8 billion, while directly investing over 1 billion in 1145
companies. Our comprehensive support system includes a worldwide network of [mentors][166],
[investors][167], and [strategic partners][168], allowing us to transform ideas into scalable,
market-ready businesses.

# **What we do**

We provide a sweat-equity model (work for equity), whether through our [Technical Cofounder][191]
program for product development or our [Grow Your Startup][192] program for business growth. We also
invest directly in startups and help founders raise capital through warm introductions in our [Raise
Capital][193] program.

[

### Mega Financing

Funding for large-scale projects ($100M - $10B) via VCs, banks, and grants.

][194]

Raise funds through our vast network of 155k+ angels & 50k+ VCs.

][195]

## Latest news updates for HCA Florida Healthcare

[Sam Boadi named CEO of South Tampa and West Tampa hospitals][100]

July 24, 2026

Boadi comes to the position from HCA Florida Oak Hill Hospital, where he served as chief operating
officer.

[HCA Florida Northside Hospital earns highest rating for Heart Care from Society of Thoracic
Surgeons][101]

July 23, 2026

The STS star rating system is one of the most respected measures of quality in cardiothoracic
surgery and is based on outcomes including mortality, complications, and adherence to best
practices.

[HCA Florida Healthcare hosts Free Stop the Bleed and Hands-Only CPR training][102]

July 23, 2026

Learn lifesaving skills for free this August. HCA Florida Healthcare is offering free Stop the
Bleed® training in Bradenton, Venice and Fort Myers, with Hands-Only CPR instruction also available
at the Venice and Fort Myers sessions.

# Data on a mission

## Better Outcomes Start with Better Insights

Data clarity is decision clarity. Empower your team with real-time intelligence to improve community
health and safety outcomes.

## The World’s Most Trusted Emergency Response Ecosystem

Spend more time on the mission and less time on paperwork. With the ESO field-tested, Intelligent
Ecosystem, your team can seamlessly share real-time data and collaborate with partners to make
informed decisions, manage quality improvement, enhance responsiveness, and ultimately help improve
outcomes.   

## Who we serve

* [Fire]
  Fire
  
  Modernize fire management with strategic insights that improve performance, anticipate future
  needs, and keep operations and responders ready for what’s next.
  
  [Learn More][40]

  Improve documentation and close the clinical loop with tools purpose-built for paramedics. Ensure
  records are complete, accurate, and accessible when it matters.
  
  [Learn More][41]

  Securely share patient records with prehospital partners in real time, so every care team has what
  it needs to improve care quality and outcomes.
  
  [Learn More][42]

  judge and jury visible in the background.]

  Go beyond compliance with insights that help your team anticipate risk, stay ahead of emerging
  trends, and understand the issues shaping your community.

# Data on a mission

## Better Outcomes Start with Better Insights

Data clarity is decision clarity. Empower your team with real-time intelligence to improve community
health and safety outcomes.

## The World’s Most Trusted Emergency Response Ecosystem

Spend more time on the mission and less time on paperwork. With the ESO field-tested, Intelligent
Ecosystem, your team can seamlessly share real-time data and collaborate with partners to make
informed decisions, manage quality improvement, enhance responsiveness, and ultimately help improve
outcomes.   

## Who we serve

### From the Field. For the Field.
* [Fire]
  Fire
  
  Modernize fire management with strategic insights that improve performance, anticipate future
  needs, and keep operations and responders ready for what’s next.
  
  [Learn More][40]
* [EMS]
  EMS
  
  Improve documentation and close the clinical loop with tools purpose-built for paramedics. Ensure
  records are complete, accurate, and accessible when it matters.
  
  [Learn More][41]
* [A healthcare professional in blue scrubs with a stethoscope uses a digital tablet.]
  Hospital
  
  Securely share patient records with prehospital partners in real time, so every care team has what
  it needs to improve care quality and outcomes.
  
  [Learn More][42]
* [A lawyer in a beige suit gestures while speaking at a wooden podium in a courtroom, with the
  judge and jury visible in the background.]
  Government
  
  Go beyond compliance with insights that help your team anticipate risk, stay ahead of emerging
  trends, and understand the issues shaping your community.
  
  [Learn More][43]

KaLinda Evans, RN

[Blake Boyd]

> With a platform that’s intuitive in the field and powerful behind the scenes – and a team that
> listens and builds with departments in mind – ESO is helping agencies get ready for what’s next.

Blake Boyd

Fire and Emergency Services Analyst

About Infirmary Health

# **The largest non-governmental healthcare system in the state of Alabama. **

Since 1910, Infirmary Health has provided the Gulf Coast region state-of-the-art and compassionate
care. Today, Infirmary Health is the largest private, not-for-profit health system in Alabama.
Infirmary Health is comprised of three acute care hospitals, one long-term acute care hospital, two
post-acute care facilities, four ambulatory surgery centers, and over 60 physician practice
locations. The health system is set apart by its 6,700+ team members, growing physician network, and
50+ service lines.

With state-of-the-art facilities close to home, we seek to provide excellent medical services to as
many people in the Gulf Coast region as possible. Our mission is LIFE: Leadership, Integrity,
Family, & Excellent Service, and our vision is to be the FIRST CHOICE for healthcare in the Gulf
Coast region.
* [ACHC Accredited]

**Proud award recipients at many of our locations.
[View All Awards][90] **
Our Services **Providing the highest quality care.**
[Medical staff person smiling with older man]

Our continuum of care includes wellness programs, inpatient and outpatient services, and
rehabilitation. Infirmary Health offers advanced-level care and cutting-edge equipment and
procedures. Our highly skilled and experienced team is prepared to serve patients across the
continuum of care.
* [Cardiovascular][91]
* [Orthopaedics][92]
* [Primary Care][93]
* [Women's Health][94]

[View All Services][95]
[Cancer patient with staff member smiling]
Infirmary Cancer Care

Infirmary Cancer Care is an affiliate of the UAB O'Neal Comprehensive Cancer Center, the only
NCI-designated comprehensive cancer center in Alabama. Our multidisciplinary team of experts
collaborate on each patient's case throughout their treatment. Patients can expect access to
high-quality cancer treatment, including clinical trials, close to home.

[Learn More][96]
Our Locations **Proudly Serving
the Alabama Gulf Coast **

We serve patients across southern Alabama, as well as the Florida panhandle and southern
Mississippi, with more than 700 physicians on the medical staff and 6,700+ employees.

About Infirmary Health

# **The largest non-governmental healthcare system in the state of Alabama. **

Since 1910, Infirmary Health has provided the Gulf Coast region state-of-the-art and compassionate
care. Today, Infirmary Health is the largest private, not-for-profit health system in Alabama.
Infirmary Health is comprised of three acute care hospitals, one long-term acute care hospital, two
post-acute care facilities, four ambulatory surgery centers, and over 60 physician practice
locations. The health system is set apart by its 6,700+ team members, growing physician network, and
50+ service lines.

With state-of-the-art facilities close to home, we seek to provide excellent medical services to as
many people in the Gulf Coast region as possible. Our mission is LIFE: Leadership, Integrity,
Family, & Excellent Service, and our vision is to be the FIRST CHOICE for healthcare in the Gulf
Coast region.
* [ACHC Accredited]

**Proud award recipients at many of our locations.
[View All Awards][90] **
Our Services **Providing the highest quality care.**
[Medical staff person smiling with older man]

Our continuum of care includes wellness programs, inpatient and outpatient services, and
rehabilitation. Infirmary Health offers advanced-level care and cutting-edge equipment and
procedures. Our highly skilled and experienced team is prepared to serve patients across the
continuum of care.

Infirmary Cancer Care

Infirmary Cancer Care is an affiliate of the UAB O'Neal Comprehensive Cancer Center, the only
NCI-designated comprehensive cancer center in Alabama. Our multidisciplinary team of experts
collaborate on each patient's case throughout their treatment. Patients can expect access to
high-quality cancer treatment, including clinical trials, close to home.

[Learn More][96]

the Alabama Gulf Coast **

We serve patients across southern Alabama, as well as the Florida panhandle and southern
Mississippi, with more than 700 physicians on the medical staff and 6,700+ employees.

[Chaperone Policy][133]
Chaperones are staff available to support you during any physical exam, medical visit, or dental
visit. They ensure a safe, respectful, and professional environment for patients and providers. Your
well-being is our top priority. Every patient — and every health care professional — has the right
to request a chaperone during a medical examination.

enjoy a simpler health care experience – with more opportunities for virtual care.] ][137]
[My Military Health: Improving the Patient Experience][138]
Great health care is more than just appointments and treatments. With My Military Health, you’ll
enjoy a simpler health care experience – with more opportunities for virtual care. Powered by
advanced digital tools, My Military Health helps you engage in your health when, where, and how you
need to. Learn more about DHA's New Model of Care!
[ [MHS GENESIS, the new electronic health record for the Military Health System, provides enhanced,
secure technology to manage your health information. MHS GENESIS integrates inpatient and outpatient
solutions that will connect medical and dental information across the continuum of care, from point
of injury to the military treatment facility. This includes garrison, operational, and en route
care, increasing efficiencies for beneficiaries and healthcare professionals. MHS GENESIS provides a
single health record for service members, veterans, and their families.] ][139]
[MHS GENESIS - Electronic Health Record][140]
MHS GENESIS, the new electronic health record for the Military Health System, provides enhanced,
secure technology to manage your health information. MHS GENESIS integrates inpatient and outpatient
solutions that will connect medical and dental information across the continuum of care, from point
of injury to the military treatment facility. This includes garrison, operational, and en route
care, increasing efficiencies for beneficiaries and healthcare professionals. MHS GENESIS provides a
single health record for service members, veterans, and their families.

[My Military Health: Improving the Patient Experience][138]
Great health care is more than just appointments and treatments. With My Military Health, you’ll
enjoy a simpler health care experience – with more opportunities for virtual care. Powered by
advanced digital tools, My Military Health helps you engage in your health when, where, and how you
need to. Learn more about DHA's New Model of Care!

secure technology to manage your health information. MHS GENESIS integrates inpatient and outpatient
solutions that will connect medical and dental information across the continuum of care, from point
of injury to the military treatment facility. This includes garrison, operational, and en route
care, increasing efficiencies for beneficiaries and healthcare professionals. MHS GENESIS provides a
single health record for service members, veterans, and their families.] ][139]
[MHS GENESIS - Electronic Health Record][140]
MHS GENESIS, the new electronic health record for the Military Health System, provides enhanced,
secure technology to manage your health information. MHS GENESIS integrates inpatient and outpatient
solutions that will connect medical and dental information across the continuum of care, from point
of injury to the military treatment facility. This includes garrison, operational, and en route
care, increasing efficiencies for beneficiaries and healthcare professionals. MHS GENESIS provides a
single health record for service members, veterans, and their families.

## **NABH**
* NABH (National Accreditation Board for Hospitals & Healthcare Providers) is an organization in
  India that sets standards for quality healthcare services in various healthcare settings such as
  hospitals, clinics, and nursing homes. NABH accreditation is the recognition that a healthcare
  facility has met these quality standards and is committed to providing safe, effective, and
  patient-centered care.
* A NABH consultant is a professional who provides guidance and assistance to healthcare facilities
  seeking NABH accreditation. Their role is to help healthcare facilities understand the NABH
  standards and requirements, assess their current practices and procedures, identify areas for
  improvement, and develop and implement a plan to meet the NABH standards.

[ READ MORE ][40]

* Supervising and managing a team of claims processors and administrators to ensure timely and
  accurate processing of health insurance claims.
* Reviewing and verifying the accuracy and completeness of claim submissions, including medical
  records, bills, and other supporting documents.
* Adjudicating claims by established policies and procedures, ensuring compliance with regulatory
  requirements and contractual obligations.
* Negotiating with healthcare providers to resolve disputed claims, including fees and reimbursement
  amounts.
* Analyzing claim data and identifying trends or patterns that may indicate fraudulent or abusive
  billing practices.
* Developing and implementing strategies to improve claims processing efficiency and accuracy, and
  reduce claims costs.
* Collaborating with other departments, such as customer service, network management, and medical
  management, to ensure seamless and coordinated delivery of health benefits to members.

## **Benefit to Hospitals**
* Cashless processing eliminates the need for manual cash handling and associated administrative
  tasks, such as counting, reconciling, and depositing cash. This leads to increased operational
  efficiency, as hospital staff can focus on core responsibilities instead of cash management.

### Health insurance plans crafted for you

Peak Health is a health insurer and health insurance services company headquartered in Morgantown,
West Virginia. We are owned by three not-for-profit healthcare providers: WVU Health System,
Marshall Health Network, and Valley Health. This allows us to have a completely collaborative
approach to insurance that will connect the bridge between the provider and the payer.

[Learn more][50]

#### Institutes at WVU Medicine

[WVU Cancer Institute][51]
[WVU Critical Care & Trauma Institute][52]
[WVU Medicine Golisano Children's][53]
[WVU Eye Institute][54]
[WVU Heart & Vascular Institute][55]
[WVU Rockefeller Neuroscience Institute][56]
At WVU Medicine, we restore lives, pioneer breakthroughs, and believe in hope.
